                            SNIPPETS IN CODE
                           __________________


Verbatim `@@ascii:ASC@@ and @@html:H@@' and code `@@latex:L@@ {{{m}}}'
text.

Inline shown and and here.

,----
| @@ascii:in example@@ {{{m}}} [[https://example.org]] *b*
`----

,----
| echo @@ascii:in src@@ {{{m}}}
`----

,----
| fixed @@ascii:width@@ {{{m}}}
`----
